hooks.command: if command -v dotbrain >/dev/null 2>&1; then dotbrain hook session-start; fi
hooks.commandWindows: if (Get-Command dotbrain -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { dotbrain hook session-start }

hooks.command: if command -v dotbrain >/dev/null 2>&1; then dotbrain hook stop; fi
hooks.commandWindows: if (Get-Command dotbrain -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { dotbrain hook stop }

hooks.command: if command -v dotbrain >/dev/null 2>&1; then dotbrain hook session-end; fi
hooks.commandWindows: if (Get-Command dotbrain -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { dotbrain hook session-end }
